topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: The development flow must not be stopped.
The OpenCode agent then said it may only start po, tech-lead, dev, qa, release, curator, and security, so it fail-closed instead of skipping the critic or starting /execute.

A fresh phase child may repair only its own invalid continuation pair. The /auto orchestrator still must not write or repair docs/engineering/state.md or handoffs/resume_brief.md (DEC-0153 / BUG-0035). RESUME_BRIEF_AUTO_REFRESH=0 stays absolute. Hard security denies (.env, secrets, credential theft) stay hard stops. Do not loosen every OpenCode edit glob. The critic dead-end is fixed by spawning 	ech-lead for /sovereign-critic, not by adding a critic Task role and not by skipping the critic when CROSS_MODEL_REVIEW=1.

A contract test proves OpenCode /auto with CROSS_MODEL_REVIEW=1 spawns 	ech-lead for /sovereign-critic and does not stop with PHASE_ROLE_CAPABILITY_MISSING for a missing critic role. A second contract proves a fresh phase child can repair its own invalid continuation pair and continue. A third proves the orchestrator still cannot write that pair.
Whenever permission problems or faulty states occur, agents must be allowed to repair themselves and repair the state.

decomposition.why_not_split: One operator outcome: OpenCode /auto continues through the critic hook and a faulty continuation pair. Constraints and tests are acceptance of that slice, not separate stories.
boundaries: not a widening of every OpenCode edit glob

bug_routing_guard.note: Exit 0 does not allocate a BUG. Story id US-0157 allocated after small-intake-pack coverage was completed by assumption confirmation.

duplicate_check.overlap_notes: US-0104 DONE already requires a fresh tech-lead /sovereign-critic spawn. US-0119 DONE keeps PHASE_ROLE_CAPABILITY_MISSING security-hard. US-0156 DONE does not cover critic-role dead-ends or phase-child continuation repair. DEC-0153 Accepted stays in force: the phase child writes the continuation pair; the spawn-only parent does not; no self-heal and no RESUME_BRIEF_AUTO_REFRESH=0 bypass. New story, not an extension of those DONE items.
